glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形). Multiple interpretations: • A stone altar – original form of 祖. • A sacrificial vessel used for chopping and holding meat, as viewed from above (Wang, 1923) – original form of 俎. • An erect penis, the symbol of the male ancestor (Guo Moruo, 1931) – original form of 祖. In the oracle bones and bronze inscriptions, this character was commonly used as 祖; usage as 俎 is not attested until the Warring States period in the bamboo script. See also the original version of 查.
senses: [cú] alternative form of 徂 (“to go to”)
